korDisplacementRead: KOR is already JWDA's go-to structural partner on high-rise residential work in San Diego — proactively engaging on Accolade Campanile and the pipeline of upcoming towers before DCI Engineers or VCA Structural are retained would consolidate KOR's position across all JWDA project types.

newsHeadlines.title: The Lindley Wins Best Amenities at Multi-Housing News Excellence Awards
newsHeadlines.summary: JWDA's 37-story mixed-use Lindley tower in San Diego's Little Italy won the Gold Award for Best Amenities at the 2025 Multi-Housing News Excellence Awards.

newsHeadlines.title: Weingart Tower Team Honored by AIA Los Angeles as 2025 Building Team of the Year
newsHeadlines.summary: The JWDA-led project team for Weingart Tower 1A, a permanent supportive housing adaptive-reuse project in LA, was named AIA Los Angeles's 2025 Building Team of the Year.

newsHeadlines.title: Harrington Heights Celebrates Grand Opening
newsHeadlines.summary: JWDA's 15-story, 273-unit affordable housing tower in San Diego's East Village officially opened, with nearly 100% of units designated affordable.

newsHeadlines.title: JWDA Breaks Ground on Accolade Campanile at SDSU
newsHeadlines.summary: JWDA broke ground on Accolade Campanile, a six-story 310-unit student housing community at SDSU, slated for completion June 2028.

newsHeadlines.title: Matthew Geaman Named on 2024 Leaders of Influence List
newsHeadlines.summary: JWDA Managing Principal Matthew Geaman was recognized by the San Diego Business Journal on its 2024 Leaders of Influence list in Architecture & Design.
